QuestInfo.name: Confirming the Seal
QuestInfo.0: #bCategory: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Prerequisite Quest\r\n Content: Go to Robeira and find out the location where Rex, the Hoblin King, is sealed.
QuestInfo.1: As #bRobeira#k instructed you, go confirm the seal. If you cannot find the Ice Gorge, forfeit the quest and talk to Robeira again.\n\nExamine the location where Rex the Hoblin King is sealed and return to #bShammos#k.
QuestInfo.2: You confirmed with your own eyes that Rex the Hoblin King is sealed up and told so to Shammos. He seems to have calmed down now.

0.0: Are you crazy!? You're just going to take Shammos at his word? \r\n#b#L0#Well, it's not that I trust him, I just feel sorry for him. If we don't calm him down, I'm worried he might give himself a heart attack.#l\n#k
0.1: You pity him?! You don't even know anything about him! \r\nYou know what? Forget it. I don't want to waste any more time on that miserable Hoblin's delusions. If you want to go, then go. Just do NOT put your hands on the seal. Got it?

yes.0: Leave El Nath and go east. You'll reach #bIce Valley 2#k. From there, head to the #bIce Ravine Entrance#k and go through the cave to enter the Ice Gorge. You won't find anything there, since it's so cold. You better prepare yourself. It's much colder than even El Nath.

no.0: What? Are you just wasting my time?

default.0: If you want to go check the seal, forfeit the quest and talk to me.
